zh.principle: **术语**：阿尔贝蒂密码盘（Alberti Cipher Disk）。装置构造在留存的课程讲义里有完整一段：阿尔贝蒂的设计是「a pair of concentric copper disks that rotated independently」，外圈较大且固定、承载明文字母，内圈较小且可动、承载一张打乱过的密文字母表；把内圈转到新位置就换一张替换表。手册第 7 章 §7.8 的注记对同一装置只给两句概述，因此该条目的机制描述以讲义为准。
zh.why: 为什么要用盘：讲义说「Turning the inner disk to a new position set a new substitution alphabet.」——换表从此变成一个物理动作，双方只需约定起始对齐并在需要时转动内盘。同一节记下它的效果：一个明文字母在不同位置可以落到不同密文字母上，而这正是多表设想要买的东西。
zh.used: 可核证的操作口径都在讲义里：双方「The sender and receiver agreed on a starting alignment, such as outer A against inner G」，先用这一对齐加密若干词，再转内盘换新表，并在电文里插入一个记号字母示意换表；讲义同时写明双方必须持有完全相同的盘，而阿尔贝蒂建议按不规则的间隔换表，好让换表点更难被看出。同一节还把该装置归到他所著的密码论文书里。复算记在 calculations 中：以留存件明载的两处对齐（外 A 对内 G、外 R 对内 M，即明文 R 得密文 M）构造盘模型，模型必须复现这两个映射，且内盘转动即换一张替换表、转过一整圈复原原表——后两项是旋转模型自身的性质，不是对留存件的测量，记录中已如此标注；留存件实际印出的字母 R 在三个对齐下得到三个不同密文字母（M、Z、Q），对应留存件印出的 "One plaintext symbol could now map to many ciphertext symbols depending on its position in the message"；规则切换与不规则切换在同一 24 字母块上的周期一致性分别实测为 1.000 与 0.125，正是该文献所说改变应对齐时机的作用；最后验证双方须持同盘方可复原，异盘不能。
zh.broken: 限度由讲义一句话说清：装置「It left open the question of when to switch and by how much.」——它解决怎么换表的机械问题，把何时换、换多少留成一条必须由双方约定的规则；同一节接着说，若这条规则产生可预测的对齐序列，就等于给分析者留下可找的模式。至于两次换表之间，手册 §7.8 的说法是对齐本身定义的是简单替换，单字母频率照旧成立。
zh.history: 断代句在手册 §7.8 的注记开头：「Polyalphabetic ciphers were invented circa 1467 by the Florentine architect Alberti」，随后两句给出盘的结构与写几词后转动的规则。年份带 circa，属手册的史述口径；讲义一侧对同一件事写的是 1467 年由佛罗伦萨建筑师阿尔贝蒂设计，两处给出的年份一致，因此本行时代落在 1450–1600 的文艺复兴窗口，人物标签按同一句写为建筑师阿尔贝蒂。

zh: 阿尔贝蒂密码盘：外圈与内圈错开索引字母的可旋转圆盘。
cipher disk（密码盘）：靠盘面对齐给出替换关系的装置。
outer wheel（外圈）：按明文字母索引的一圈。
inner wheel（内圈）：按密文字母索引的一圈。
letter alignment（字母对齐）：某一盘面位置给出的一对一替换。
rotation（转动）：写完若干词后改变对齐、从而换表的操作。
en: Alberti cipher disk: a rotatable disk whose two wheels index letters differently.
cipher disk: the device whose alignment supplies the substitution.
outer wheel: the ring indexed by plaintext characters.
inner wheel: the ring indexed by ciphertext characters.
letter alignment: the one-to-one mapping a given disk position gives.
rotation: changing that alignment after a few words, which switches alphabet.

calculations.inputs: a disk model with the outer alphabet fixed and an inner arrangement satisfying the two alignments the text prints (outer A against inner G, outer R against inner M)
calculations.expected: the two alignments are parsed out of the registered course text at run time (outer A against inner G; outer R maps to inner M) and the inner arrangement is built from those parsed constraints; the model must reproduce both printed mappings, keep them consistent with a single permutation, change the alphabet when the inner disk turns and restore it after a full revolution, must change the substitution alphabet when the inner disk is rotated, and must restore the original alphabet after one full turn
calculations.limitations: Only inner[0]=G and inner[17]=M are printed; the other 24 positions are an arbitrary scramble here and no historical arrangement is claimed.

calculations.inputs: the letter R - the one the printed mapping names - enciphered under three alignments (0, 5, 11)
calculations.expected: the text says one plaintext symbol can now map to many ciphertext symbols depending on its position; three alignments must give three different letters
calculations.limitations: Three alignments of one letter; the check shows the mechanism, it does not measure security.

calculations.inputs: the same 24-letter block enciphered with a regular alignment rule (0,1,2 repeating) and with an irregular one (0,7,3,19,11,2,23)
calculations.expected: Alberti suggested changing at irregular intervals to make the switching harder to detect: an analyst assuming the regular period-3 rule is consistent with itself at 1.000 on the first and materially lower on the second
calculations.limitations: A single assumed-period detector on a short block; it demonstrates why the rule matters, it does not prove any particular rule safe.

calculations.inputs: a 17-letter block enciphered with alignments cycling 0,4,8 on one inner arrangement, then decrypted with the same and with a different inner arrangement
calculations.expected: the source states both parties had to have identical disks: the same arrangement must recover the block, a different one must not
calculations.limitations: One round-trip pair; the failure of the wrong disk is the point, not a measure of work factor.
